_source: Chola deal/scheme emails (M&H CV Exceptional Deal, Sep'26) write human state names, but the Chola grid keys regions as STATE CODES plus the MH special clusters resolved by services/chola-region.js (Mumbai/GA/Pune/Central MH vs ROM). Without this map the ingested overlay rules matched nothing and the scheme never paid.
_note: Keys are matched case-insensitively on the WHOLE region label. A key may map to SEVERAL canonical regions - expandZones() emits one rule per entry, which is how 'Maharashtra & Mumbai' correctly covers both MH clusters (USER 2026-09-24).
